title: Volunteer Chaperone Information Sheet
subtitle: Capture trip assignment, student group, screening status, and supervision boundary; confirm emergency route and return handoff.
description: Volunteer Chaperone records trip assignment, student group, screening status, supervision boundary, emergency route, and return handoff. Volunteer Chaperone evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this volunteer chaperone controlled information handoff when staff must document trip assignment and student group. Reconcile screening status, supervision boundary, emergency route, and return handoff before the volunteer chaperone handoff. Use screening evidence, assignment roster, student-group list, supervision brief, emergency card route, transport seat list, checkpoint headcounts, and return handoff. This assignment places a screened adult with a student group using ratio and supervision boundaries, bus position, checkpoint headcounts, emergency response role, prohibited tasks, and return handoff. Ask the assigned volunteer chaperone reviewer to confirm trip assignment against the organization's policy.
